clue.text: Flier abandoned by fellow flier

indicators.note: abandoned in the sense of wild, unrestrained, so the letters of the first word run loose

parts.note: a flier here is a bird; the New Zealand ... is a tiny wren
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: An airman ditched by a colleague in the squadron.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' scrambles FLIER into RIFLE. Both fliers look like pilots; the second is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the rifleman is a small New Zealand bird, so a creature that flies.

clue.text: Wayward, sleepy feature endures, given sun

parts.note: REM, rapid eye movement, is a feature of sleep
to endure is to exist, which is what is says

explanation.surface: An erratic sleeper's dream phase lasts on into the sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: negligent, falling short of duty, straying from what should be done.

clue.text: Style of pro wrestling requirement?

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
wrestlers grapple on a mat

explanation.surface: The fashion sense of a professional wrestler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pro' looks like a professional but is the preposition meaning in favour of.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the arrangement or layout in which something is presented.

clue.text: Cover of only half useful navigational aid?

parts.note: a compass showing only two of its four cardinal points, east and north, is half useful
a compass guides navigators

explanation.surface: A half-working compass offers little cover.
explanation.walkthrough: The '?' flags the whimsy: a compass with just E and N, half of N, E, S and W.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to include or take in all of, as a survey spans a topic.

clue.text: A gift that hits just the right note

definitions.text: A gift that hits just the right note

parts.words: A gift that hits just the right note
parts.note: sounds like praise for a well-chosen present, but means a musical talent for naming or singing any note exactly

explanation.surface: A present that strikes exactly the right tone.
explanation.definitionFit: A rare talent for identifying or producing a musical note without a reference tone.

clue.text: Feature of London breaks: bagging husband!

indicators.note: bagging means pocketing, so the word for breaks holds the other piece

parts.note: to break a horse is to tame it

explanation.surface: A city's routine is disrupted when someone lands a husband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' looks like a noun but is the verb, as in breaking in horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the river flowing through the capital is one of its best-known landmarks.

clue.text: Ancient slave, male, with parcel

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
a parcel or lot is a portion, as at auction

explanation.surface: An old slave and a man carrying a package.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parcel' suggests a package; here it is a batch, as of land or goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical term: a serf of ancient Sparta, owned by the state.

clue.text: Hurt film, awfully jolly

indicators.note: awfully means badly, so these letters are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: A painful movie, yet terribly cheerful.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: full of laughter and good cheer.

clue.text: Zapped steed absorbs a certain quantity of electricity charge

indicators.note: absorbs means soaks up, so the scrambled horse takes in the unit
zapped means blasted, so the horse's letters are knocked about

parts.note: an amp is a unit of electric current

explanation.surface: An electrocuted horse soaks up some current and charges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charge' reads as electrical, matching the surface, but it is the headlong rush of a herd.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a headlong rush, as of a herd bolting forward.

clue.text: Instruments responsible for a calcium-filled world

indicators.note: filled means the planet's name has something put inside it

parts.note: Mars is a world, a planet
Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium

explanation.surface: Some instruments are blamed for a planet stuffed with calcium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'responsible for' is only a link between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun: Latin American percussion instruments shaken to rattle beads or seeds.

clue.text: Shop with retro atmosphere excited states

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen, a kind of shop

indicators.note: retro means backward-looking, so the word for atmosphere is read backwards

parts.note: the atmosphere is the air

explanation.surface: A shop with an old-fashioned vibe whips up excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of delirium: frenzied, wildly agitated conditions of mind.

clue.text: Photo of partygoer dancing with due energy

indicators.note: dancing means moving about, so these letters are shuffled

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A snapshot of a reveller dancing with the expected vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an early photograph made on a silvered copper plate, named after Louis Daguerre.

clue.text: Width covered by mock instrument

indicators.note: covered by means placed inside the next word's synonym

parts.note: mock as an adjective means fake, sham

explanation.surface: A mock instrument hides its true width.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a medieval double-reed woodwind, forerunner of the oboe.

clue.text: Prepares to smoke joint, as a warning to seamen

parts.note: someone about to smoke lights a cigarette
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: Someone lights a joint, a cautionary tale for sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' suggests cannabis but is the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A moored vessel with a beacon serving as a floating lighthouse, alerting sailors to hazards.

clue.text: "Culloden", revolving turntable dog?

indicators.note: revolving means turning round, so these letters are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: Picture a record called Culloden spinning while a dog sits on the turntable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolving' rearranges TURNTABLE and DOG together. Culloden, near Inverness, was the last pitched battle on British soil, in 1746.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Culloden is the site of the 1746 Jacobite defeat, a field of combat.

clue.text: Small car that's given by evasive person

definitions.meaning: a compact car for short local trips
what a dodger gives you: deliberate stalling and evasion

explanation.surface: A dodgy dealer hands over a little car.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a small town car, and a pattern of deceitful avoidance.

clue.text: Composer with chart entry devoid of skill — it's hot!

indicators.note: entry means going in, so the trimmed word is put inside the composer

parts.note: one who scores music, writing a score, is a scorer

indicators.note: devoid of means lacking, so the word for skill is taken out

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of persuasion

explanation.surface: A composer gets in the charts without talent, on a hot day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composer' is not a named musician but anyone who writes a score.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal: a very hot day, or anything blisteringly hot.

clue.text: Question about rampant greed that divides the land?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the question word goes round the rest

parts.note: how is a question word

indicators.note: rampant means running wild, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking about unchecked greed that splits a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description, with the '?' signalling it is loose: a hedge row splits fields.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a line of bushes marking a field boundary, splitting farmland.

clue.text: Mean to be cutting down dairy produce

definitions.meaning: mean as an adjective: stingy, penny-pinching
whittling away a dairy product, read literally as two words

explanation.surface: Stinginess is reducing the cheese you buy.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: excessive frugality, from paring the rind thin to save every scrap.

clue.text: Primate admitting self-elevation is the highest point

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the primate holds the other piece

parts.note: an ape is a primate

indicators.note: elevation means raising, so in a down answer the word is read upwards

parts.note: ego is the self

explanation.surface: An ape showing self-importance reaches its peak.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer, 'elevation' means read upwards, since the entry runs downwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the climax or peak, originally an orbit's farthest point from Earth.

clue.text: Cross borne by worthy bridegroom

indicators.note: borne by means carried within, so the answer is held in these words

explanation.surface: A burden carried by a worthy groom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like an angry adjective or a burden; it is a mixed breed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a crossbreed, offspring of two different kinds.

clue.text: City welcomes attempt to hire theatre entrance for opera

indicators.note: welcomes means takes in, so the city's name holds the rest

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, often just Rio, is a Brazilian city
a go is an attempt
to let is to hire out

indicators.note: entrance means the way in, so only the opening letter of theatre is used

explanation.surface: A city invites bids to rent a theatre's foyer for an opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' is the noun, the way in, standing for the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Verdi's 1851 work about a hunchbacked court jester.

clue.text: Possibly heard as a Russian dog

indicators.note: possibly heard means said out loud, roughly matching

parts.note: as a means the same as like a

explanation.surface: Something may sound like a Russian dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' admits the sound is only rough.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the first animal in orbit, aboard Sputnik 2 in 1957; also a Russian hunting breed.

clue.text: Lasso-like? Yes, cowboy-style with gold backing

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the combined pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: yep is a drawling, Western way to say yes
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A cowboy drawls agreement while backing a gold-standard lasso.
explanation.walkthrough: The usual meaning is shoddy; the '?' flags the literal sense of like a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword-only sense: taken literally as resembling a cord, which a cowboy's loop is.

clue.text: Port flushed air WC in two hours

indicators.note: in places the shuffled letters between the two others

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hour, twice

indicators.note: flushed suggests churning water, so these letters are churned around

explanation.surface: In a port, air freshener and a flushed toilet take two hours.
explanation.walkthrough: Harwich is a ferry port in Essex, on England's east coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Essex town is a harbour handling ferries to the Netherlands.

clue.text: Say name backward, restricted by one's being less mature

indicators.note: restricted by means hemmed in by the possessive pronoun

parts.note: one's, meaning belonging to the person addressed, is your

indicators.note: backward means the combined short pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: say means for example, e.g.

explanation.surface: Saying a name backwards marks someone as less grown-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' is not speech but the abbreviation for for example.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative adjective: of fewer years, so not as grown-up.

clue.text: Soldiers finish filming and provide cover again

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, an army corps
it's a wrap is said on set when filming ends

explanation.surface: Soldiers wrap up a film shoot and repackage things.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to put fresh packaging or covering on something a second time.

clue.text: Useless chap, tidy up the flower bed!

definitions.meaning: a dull, ineffectual person, a dud
to remove spent blooms from plants

explanation.surface: A gardener tells a lazy man to get tidying.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a dull, unproductive person, and the gardening task of snipping off withered blooms.
